region.finding: All 24 enlarged source and battle face/body front/side slices actually inspected, 13 clips at six phases. Lower white muzzle, mouth edge and side jaw visibly flatten and elongate with neck/torso motion in alternate idle, gallop jump, attack, recoil, cast, victory and defeat. Eyes, ears, headband and ties, scarf, all four booted legs and complete curled tail otherwise coherent. Brightness 2.5 analysis copies inspected with originals retained. Repair must preserve scarf, legs and curled tail articulation.

All 24 enlarged source and battle face/body front/side slices actually inspected across all 13 clips at six phases, using the production showdown-v2 asset. Lower white cheek, mouth/chin and side jaw compress with torso and shoulder during alternate idle, jump, recoil, strike, cast, victory and defeat. Eyes, long ears, blue headband/ties, scarf, sheathed sword, arms/hands, wrapped legs/feet and small tail remain coherent. Brightness 2.5 analysis copies inspected with originals retained. Requires lower face repair preserving scarf and limb motion.

All 24 enlarged source and battle face/body front/side slices actually inspected, all 13 clips at six phases. Lower black muzzle, whiskers, cheek/chin and eye rim squash, stretch and move with the near arm and torso in gallop, jump, attack, recoil, guard, entrance and defeat. The chin becomes an elongated wedge while eyes flatten independently of the headband. Ears, blue headband/ties, red scarf, sword, arms/hands, legs/feet and full curved tail remain coherent otherwise. Requires complete face binding repair preserving limbs and scarf motion. Brightness 2.5 analysis copies inspected with originals retained.
All 13 original full-body and complete head clips inspected front/side. Eyes, beak and skull coherent; original dense geometric/blend check passes. No repair needed; complete second pass pending.

All 24 enlarged source and battle face/body front/side slices actually inspected, 13 clips at six phases. White whisker pads, nose, mouth and chin mostly retain shape, with a small residual pull at the lower side jaw during attack, recoil and defeat corroborated by independent face drift. Eyes, ears, headband/ties, scarf and torso wraps, arms/hands, legs/feet and full tail remain coherent. Requires a localized jaw binding cleanup preserving cloth and limbs. Brightness 2.5 analysis copies inspected with originals retained.
